fields.label: Campaign
fields.name: campaign
fields.instructions: Campaign name to send to the donation app

fields.label: Use donation app
fields.name: use_donation_app
fields.message: Check this to send users to the donation app

fields.label: Default frequency
fields.name: frequency_start
fields.instructions: Also controls preview. Norway monthly wont show instead a link to 'Solidus' is set by default in the settings and shouldn't need changing

fields.label: Preview currency
fields.name: preview
fields.instructions: What currency do you want to see in the editor?

fields.label: Custom thank you page (optional)
fields.name: custom_thankyou
fields.instructions: This will only work if the thank you page has been created and 'thank you page scripts' has been checked in the 'footer options' on that thank you page. This will not work for Gocardless., UK Guardians will be sent to the default donation thank you page.

fields.label: Tracked campaign name
fields.name: tracked
fields.instructions: Is this campaign tracked within WordPress? Add the table name here if so. If you aren't sure get in touch with comms and leave this empty.

sub_fields.default_value: c
